logline: Theo has been dating a girl he met in an online game for two years. They've never seen each other's faces. She just booked a flight to meet him in 100 days, and every single thing he ever told her about himself is a lie. The comments decide how he makes the lies true.
premise: For two years Theo (23, basement-dweller, never leaves the house) has been in an online relationship with 'Pixie', a girl he met in a co-op fantasy game. Cameras never on. They talk every night.
Day 1: Pixie texts: 'i booked my flight. 100 days. i finally get to meet you <3'.
Problem: Theo told her he's a 6'2" firefighter with abs, who plays guitar, speaks French, cooks, has a dog and his own apartment. He is none of those things.
He has 100 days to make the lies true (or at least close enough). He can't decide anything himself, so the most-liked comment picks what he works on every day.
His mom Deb is thrilled ('a GIRL?!') and terrified. His cousin Brett bets $500 that Pixie is a catfish.
Meanwhile a girl named Nina just moved in across the street. She keeps showing up at the worst possible moments.
end_goal: Day 100: Pixie lands. Theo has made as many lies true as he can, has moved out, and confesses the rest. Twist: Pixie is Nina. She lied too (she said she was a DJ in Tokyo), recognized Theo's voice weeks ago, and has been watching him change. They both drop the act. Brett loses the bet (technically she WAS a catfish, which starts a fight about the terms).

arc.focus: Fix the basics before anything: shower, acne, unibrow, nose hairs, teeth, glasses, haircut, burn the hoodie. Pixie notices he 'sounds different lately'.
Gym (abs), cooking, guitar, French. A near-miss video-call request he dodges. First Nina run-ins.
Volunteer fire training with commenter-cameo instructors, a dog adoption, Brett tries to expose him. Clues about Pixie pile up.
Job, first paycheck, apartment hunt, leaving the basement, Deb cries. Pixie goes quiet for 3 days (cliffhanger).
Countdown. The confession plan. Day 100: the airport. The reveal.

tone: Wholesome roast. Theo is the butt of the joke, but the audience is on his side. Never cruel, never body-shaming beyond cartoon gags, and every win is celebrated loudly.

structure: HOOK (first 2 s): title card 'DAY N' + 2-line headline, character mid-reaction.
SETUP: 1-2 lines on what the comments chose (credit the commenter by @handle).
THE ATTEMPT: Theo tries it, something goes slightly wrong (comedy beat).
THE CHANGE: transformation flash, visible state change.
Optional: a Pixie text exchange on the phone screen (scene 'texts') for a cliffhanger or a laugh.
PAYOFF: reaction, a running-gag callback (Deb, Brett, Nina, or the bet).
CTA: 'Top comment decides Day N+1' + cameo invite.
format.headline_style: ALL CAPS, max ~22 characters per line, 2 lines. e.g. 'THE UNIBROW' / 'IS GONE'.

voices._note: Blends ('a:0.6,b:0.4') keep voice a's sound and pitch while borrowing b's smoother flow. Chosen by measured pitch + smoothness. Don't use plain am_michael/af_bella/af_nicole/am_onyx/bf_* alone (choppy). Tempo 1.05. 'polish': true adds compression + warmth + light room (smoother flow, same pitch).

theo.role: Main character. 23. Gamer, night owl, secretly funny and kind. Talks to his cat Gremlin. Says 'okay okay okay' when nervous.

deb.role: Theo's mom. Over the moon that he has a 'girlfriend', skeptical she exists, way too involved. Communicates through dramatic sighs and notes under the door. Secretly his biggest fan.

brett.role: Theo's cousin. Fitness influencer, says 'bro' a lot. Bet $500 that Pixie is a catfish. Antagonist who slowly becomes an ally.

nina.role: Moved in across the street on Day 1. Confident, skateboards, keeps plants, always has headphones on. SECRET (never state it before Day 95): she IS Pixie. Appears every ~5-7 days, usually catching Theo mid-disaster. Keep her and Theo's scenes short and awkward.

pixie.role: Theo's online girlfriend. Funny, chaotic, sends lots of '<3' and 'lmaooo'. NEVER shown on screen until the reveal; appears only as texts (scene 'texts') and, rarely, voice notes. Her avatar is a pink pixel heart.
pixie.text_style: lowercase, short messages, playful, teases him. Signs off 'gn nerd <3'.

running_gags: The 6'2" problem: a new absurd height attempt every so often.
Pixie's texts popping up at the worst moments.
Brett's '$500 SAYS SHE'S A CATFISH' check-ins.
Deb shouting down the stairs: 'Is that PIXIE?'
Theo's 'okay okay okay' before every challenge.

voting_rules.how: Read comments on yesterday's YouTube Short and Instagram Reel. Rank by likes (YouTube likeCount, Instagram like_count). Ignore the channel's own comments.
voting_rules.pick: Most-liked comment that is (a) a doable glow-up / life task or plot choice, (b) safe and kind, (c) not a repeat of something already done. If the top one is unusable, take the next.
voting_rules.fallback: If there are no usable comments, take the next item from backlog_ideas and say 'the comments were quiet so Gremlin picked'.
voting_rules.credit: Always credit the winner on screen and in narration: 'Top comment from @handle said...'. Reply to their comment after publishing.

cameo_rules.what: Commenters can ask to appear, e.g. 'can I be the doctor?', 'let me be his barber', 'I'll be the gym coach', 'make me the interviewer'.
cameo_rules.selection: If today's task naturally needs a helper role, pick the most-liked cameo request whose role fits. Otherwise pick at most one fun cameo (bystander, customer, judge). Max 2 cameos per episode.
cameo_rules.how_they_appear: As a cartoon guest generated from their username (look is deterministic from the handle), dressed for the role, with a name tag showing their @handle. They can have 1-2 short lines.
safety: Only use the public @handle they commented with. Never their real name, photo, location or anything else.

Skip handles that are offensive, sexual, impersonate a brand or public figure, or look like a real full name of a private person; skip handles that look like they belong to a minor's school or contain ages under 18.
Never write cameo lines that mock the commenter.
Max 18 characters shown on the name tag; truncate with an ellipsis.
cameo_rules.follow_up: After publishing, reply to the cameo comment: 'You're in Day N, go see yourself 👀'.

safety_rules: No sexual content, no self-harm or dangerous challenges, no real public figures, no hate or harassment, no medical claims beyond cartoon gags.
Comment suggestions that would be humiliating in a mean way get reframed into something Theo wins at, or skipped.
No brand names or copyrighted characters/music.

the_lies.description: The spine of the series. Show a 'LIES MADE TRUE: X/8' tracker when one is completed. Comments pick which lie to tackle, or a glow-up step toward one.

lies.note: Impossible. Running gag: increasingly ridiculous attempts (lifts, posture, hair volume, standing on things). Resolve with honesty at the end.
Path: volunteer fire training arc with commenter-cameo instructors.
Gym arc. Body goes chubby -> average -> fit across many days.
Lessons, a commenter-teacher, writes Pixie a terrible song that gets better.
Adopts a shelter dog (needs a dog renderer when it happens). Gremlin the cat is NOT happy.

secret_clues.rule: Plant one subtle Pixie=Nina clue every ~8-10 days, never more than one per episode, never confirm. Let comments theorize; if a theory comment is top-liked, Theo can dismiss it ('nah, Pixie lives in Tokyo').
clues: Pixie mentions she 'just moved' and has 'boxes everywhere' (same week Nina moved in).
Pixie texts about a plant she's repotting; next episode Nina is carrying the same plant.
Pixie says she bailed on a skate session; Nina has a scraped elbow.
Pixie's game username is a pun on Nina's street address number.
Pixie texts 'nice haircut' the day Theo gets one, before he told her.
During a power outage on Theo's street, Pixie also 'lost wifi'.
